g.text: Identical in FBA — PYC's benefit is KINETIC (PTS protection),
which FBA cannot represent: PPC overexpression competes with glucose
uptake for PEP (Chao & Liao 1993); R. etli PYC spares PEP (Gokarn 2000);

g.text: The wet-lab build ≈ WT on both carbons (it omits the overflow knockouts + exporter). In FBA, PPC and PYC give the same yield; PYC is chosen for its kinetic PTS benefit.
